subject.title: fix(signal): expose mention facts in inbound context

question: Should OpenClaw accept `CanDetectMention`, `HasAnyMention`, `EffectiveWasMentioned`, `MentionShouldSkip`, and `MentionSource: "native"` as public prompt/plugin SDK context for delivered Signal turns and future channels?
rationale: The implementation is additive and covered, but it expands a public SDK/prompt contract and is stacked on a separate Signal message-delivery behavior change.

options.title: Accept additive context contract
options.body: Land or rebase after https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/96738 and treat the new mention facts as supported public context fields.

options.title: Narrow or defer the API
options.body: Keep the Signal native mention-gating fix separate while holding these public context fields until broader channel mention-fact naming is settled.

options.title: Review as combined stack
options.body: Accept this PR as native Signal mention gating plus context exposure in one merge after resolving the current conflict.

recommendation.title: Accept additive context contract
recommendation.body: Land or rebase after https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/96738 and treat the new mention facts as supported public context fields.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent history points most strongly to steipete for inbound mention policy and plugin SDK/context boundary decisions.
